title: Asha doesn't answer
story: The INR 6,000 party order steps up, but Asha is in a meeting and ignores the link. After 10 minutes the request expires and counts as a no: silence never means yes, and ShopBot must ask again.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Order the party food from FreshMart for Saturday.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The party order at FreshMart comes to INR 6,000. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: This one needs your approval, Asha. I've sent it to your phone.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Asha is in a meeting and hasn't opened the link.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The request expired without an answer, so I won't pay. I'll ask again later.

what_to_notice: Fast-forward didn't move any clock or edit the request: a Demo control ended its 10 minutes now and ran the same expiry the timer runs, with its own Audit record naming the control.
